observed: CSRF protection is implemented and observed: state-changing requests (POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE) to actor-scoped routes must carry an X-XSRF-TOKEN header matching the okr_csrf_token double-submit cookie, and a missing or mismatched token is rejected with HTTP 403 INVALID_CSRF_TOKEN before any upstream call. Read routes are intentionally POST-based and non-mutating, and are excluded from the CSRF requirement by contract. Origin validation is not implemented: spa-bff never reads the Origin or Referer request header to decide whether to accept a request, and no allowlisted-origin configuration exists anywhere in the package. The control is named for both mechanisms, so it is recorded as pending rather than passed.
